caveat: One seed, conditional on this initialization. Family SE does not capture retraining uncertainty. Selected-epoch contrasts are descriptive after selection; primary contrasts use fixed epoch 3. This tests a short continuation after widening, not training a larger model from scratch or tuning its learning rate. No arena or reserved test evaluation.

experiment.dropout_rng: Explicit per-epoch reset; one epoch per worker invocation
experiment.optimizer: Reset AdamW for all four cells; lr 0.0001, wd 0.0001, clip 1.
experiment.primary: Paired size and loss contrasts at fixed epoch 3; same frozen composite validation objective.
experiment.secondary: Per-cell best epoch including v4 epoch 0; paired ordinary and consequential-card metrics; descriptive SE after selection.
